title: HABC/14/2026 of VAIBHAV GUPTA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Habeas Corpus Petition No.14 of 2026
Vaibhav Gupta ...... Appellant
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand ..... Respondent
Present:
Mr. Ajeet Kumar Yadav and Ram Nivas Singh Rana, Advocates for the
appellant.
Mr. J.S. Virk, D.A.G. for the State of Uttarakhand.

Coram: Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Hon'ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 The instant habeas corpus petition has been filed
by the petitioner for production of the corpus of Smt. Himanshi
Singh, whom the petitioner claims to be his wife.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused
the record.
3. According to the petitioner, he and Himanshi
Singh both are major; they were in romantic relationship; they
married on 15.04.2026. Thereafter, apprehending threats at the
hands of respondent nos.3, 4, 5 and 6, they filed Writ Petition
Criminal No.678 of 2026, Himanshi Singh and Another v. State of
Uttarakhand and Others ("the first petition") seeking protection,
which was decided by this Court on 17.04.2026 by the following
order:-
 "9. In such view of the matter, the instant writ
petition is disposed of finally with the direction to the SSP,
Haridwar - respondent no. 1 to make an assessment of the
threat perception and if he comes to the conclusion that there
is any threat from respondent nos. 3 to 14, take appropriate
steps. Simultaneously, SHO, Police Station - Bahadrabad
District - Haridwar is also directed to call upon respondent nos.
3 to 14 and advise them not to take law in his hand."
4. According to the petitioner, in the meantime, on
17.04.2026, FIR No.68 of 2026, Police Station Maharajganj,

2
District Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, was falsely filed with regard to
the missing of the corpus Himanshi Negi. On 21.04.2026, the
police intercepted the petitioner and the corpus of Himanshi
Singh. When the petitioner produced the protection order granted
by this Court on 17.04.2026 in the first petition, he was abused
and the protection order was not taken into consideration and the
police demanded Rs. 20,000/- from the petitioner, which was paid
through Unified Payments Interface ("UPI"). Thereafter, on
21.04.2026, the private respondents with the active connivance
and presence of the Uttarakhand Police Forces removed Himanshi
Singh from the territorial jurisdiction of Uttarakhand.
5. On 08.05.2026, the Court had directed the corpus
to be produced before the Court. She has been brought before the
Court by the Constable Police Kavita from Police Station
Bahadrabad, District Haridwar. On being asked, Himanshi Singh
reveals that she is post graduate in Geography; she married the
petitioner on 15.04.2026; on 17.04.2026 also, she had appeared
in this Court. According to her, her marriage with the petitioner
was willingly done, but she was taken by the private respondents
on 21.04.2026 from Laksar, and they are not allowing her to go to
her husband, the petitioner. According to her, her Uncle Pintu is
stopping her to join the company of the petitioner. Himanshi
Singh categorically tells that she wants to go with her husband,
the petitioner. According to Himanshi Singh, her date of birth is
22.10.2003.
6. Himanshi Singh is a major. According to her, she
and the petitioner both are married and she wants to join the
company of her husband, the petitioner. Therefore, she is free to
go wherever she wants to go.

3
7. The habeas corpus petition, as such, stands
disposed of, accordingly.
8. The SSP, Haridwar, shall still ensure further
assess the threat perception to the petitioner and Himanshi
Singh, and if required, adequate protection is provided to them.
9. On behalf of the petitioner, it is submitted that the
petitioner and Himanshi Singh both will go to Haridwar from here.
10. The SSP, Haridwar, shall ensure granting
protection to the petitioner and Himanshi Singh from here
(Nainital) till they reach their destination at Haridwar.
11. In the first petition, on 17.04.2026, this Court had
directed the Senior Superintendant of Police, Haridwar ("SSP"), to
make assessment of threat perception, and if any threat is
perceived, to take appropriate steps.
12. In the instant petition, allegations have been
levelled against the police of District Haridwar that they had
facilitated the removal of the corpus of Himanshi Singh from
Laksar to the State of Uttar Pradesh. Therefore, let the SSP,
Haridwar, submit a report as to under what circumstances the
order dated 17.04.2026, passed in the first petition by this Court,
has been defied by him, and why action be not taken against him?
13. There are also allegations of demand of
Rs.20,000/- by the police, which, according to the petitioner, was
transferred through UPI.
14. The SSP, Haridwar, shall also examine that aspect
as to who had demanded this money. If required, he may get a
preliminary investigation done in the matter. For this purpose, the
SSP, Haridwar, shall submit a report on or before 12.06.2026.

4
15. List this matter on 15.06.2026, as the first case.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 18.05.2026
